name: Timing-bar minigame
oneLiner: Any 'skill check' moment (picking a lock, a timed attack bonus, forging, reeling in a fish) opens a small window with a bar: a marker sweeps across bevelled miss / good / great / perfect zones and the player stops it with one press; a grade word pops, the window closes, and the game gets {grade, offset} back. Optional multi-press sequences, difficulty presets, an assist mode, and an autoplay hook that resolves at a fixed grade so ?auto=1 runs end the same.
fits: turn-based RPG battle (timed attack or defence bonus)
notFor: rhythm games (a whole track of timed notes is a different element)
real-time action where pausing the world for a check would break the flow (use an in-world timing ring instead)
checks that must stay invisible (stealth rolls)

needs: the moment that becomes a skill check (the `moment` parameter, named by the designer), in update logic (call start once; act on the result in onDone)
the confirm input routed to the bar while busy() (press(), tap() or key(code, down))
a fixed 60 Hz update step (the bar's only clock), also while the world is paused for the check
the play field size in native px, HUD excluded
optional: ui rects to keep clear (HUD, menus, dialog boxes) and the anchor of the object being worked on
provides: busy flag: route the confirm input here and pause the world while a check runs
result {grade: miss|good|great|perfect|cancel, offset, hits, score, timeout, auto} via onDone (synchronous) and a Promise
shake request (perfect, miss) and sound cue names
window rectangle on screen, for other overlays to avoid

params.label: Where the skill check goes (required; the designer's words)
params.default: opening a locked chest or door (a lockpick; on a miss it stays locked and can be retried)

params.moment: opening a locked chest or door (a lockpick; on a miss it stays locked and can be retried)
the hero's basic attack (a timed bonus: perfect x1.5, great x1.25, good x1.0, miss x0.75 damage)
forging at the anvil (three hammer blows; the result sets the item's quality)
reeling in a fish (one pass; a miss loses the fish)

assets: module/timing-bar.js: the element as one dependency-free script (global GameDNA_TimingBar): window, bar, zones, marker, judging, grade words (bold 5x7 font), sparks, placement, autoplay, drawing
no image or audio files (sound cues are names passed to onSfx)
